title: PropertyOps® single-page marketing site + consultation request intake (frontend)

requirements.summary: Build the PropertyOps® single-page homepage with the required section order and operational copy direction.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage renders all required sections in the specified order.
Hero section includes the exact headline text: “Standardized Property Operations. Done Right.”
Hero section includes the provided subheadline and a primary CTA labeled “Request a Service Consultation”.
How It Works section presents exactly three steps with the provided titles and supporting text.

Technology & Systems section includes the exact headline “Technology That Supports Operations — Not Replaces People” and clearly states systems support a U.S.-based operations team and do not replace human decision-making or labor.
Services section contains exactly these three services (no more, no less): Rental Turnover Condition Reports; Minor Turnover Repairs & Punch Lists; Exterior Maintenance Packages.
Quality Control, Contractor Model, Trust callouts, and Franchise teaser sections are present and reflect the provided content direction without “startup hype” or “AI/futuristic” language.

file_operations.description: Create the app shell that renders the single-page homepage (no additional routes) and wires the primary CTA interaction to open the consultation request UI.

Implement the homepage sections in the exact required order with calm, operational copy and semantic structure; include the hero, how-it-works (3 steps), technology & systems, services (exactly three), quality control, contractor model, trust/differentiators, and franchise teaser.

Factor homepage content into reusable section components (Hero, HowItWorks, TechnologySystems, Services, QualityControl, ContractorModel, TrustCallouts, FranchiseTeaser) to keep HomePage readable; ensure all required user-facing copy direction is represented.

Add a minimal, professional header with brand name and a primary CTA button that triggers the consultation request workflow; compose existing shadcn/ui components (e.g., Button). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a simple footer with credibility-forward, compliance-friendly positioning statements (no legal guarantees) and a secondary CTA to request a consultation.

requirements.summary: Implement an in-flow consultation request form (modal or embedded) with client-side validation, backend submission, and success state.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Request a Service Consultation” reveals a form without leaving the site flow (modal or in-page).
Form includes, at minimum: name, email, phone (optional), company/portfolio (optional), city/state (optional), request details/message, and a consent/acknowledgement checkbox.
Client-side validation prevents submission when required fields are missing and shows user-friendly inline errors.
On successful submission, the UI shows a confirmation message and clears/locks the form to prevent duplicate accidental resubmits.
Backend persists submitted consultation requests with timestamp and unique ID and exposes a query method suitable for an internal admin view later (even if the admin UI is not built now).

file_operations.description: Create a modal-based consultation request UI launched from the homepage CTA; compose shadcn/ui components (e.g., Dialog, Button, Input, Textarea, Checkbox, Label, Alert) to capture required fields, show inline errors, and present a clear success state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement the form fields, consent checkbox, validation rules, and submit handling; on success, render a confirmation message and lock/disable resubmission within the same view.
Create a React Query mutation hook that calls the backend actor capability to submit a consultation request; normalize UI-friendly error messages for failed submissions.
Wire the Hero CTA and header CTA to open the consultation request modal/embedded form without navigating away; ensure focus management and accessible labeling for the form trigger.

requirements.summary: Apply a clean, modern, professional visual theme (dark blue/slate/white with subtle green accents) using icons and a process/flow visual without AI/robot imagery.
acceptanceCriteria: Site styling consistently uses a neutral palette dominated by dark blue/slate/white with subtle green accents.
Icons are used in relevant sections (e.g., SOPs/checklists/documentation/QC) and do not include robotic/futuristic motifs.
At least one process/flow visual (diagram-like) is used to reinforce the operational workflow presentation.
Typography, spacing, and layout read as “professional/operational” (not playful, neon, or highly stylized).

file_operations.description: Create global styling using Tailwind layers and CSS variables to establish the dark blue/slate/white palette with subtle green accents; ensure consistent typography/spacing for a professional B2B look.
Apply consistent section layout, spacing, and iconography patterns; add a diagram-like flow visual presentation around the 3-step How It Works section using the provided generated diagram asset.

requirements.summary: Add SEO fundamentals (title, meta description, semantic headings, and keyword placement) with calm, operational tone.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage includes an appropriate HTML document title and meta description aligned with PropertyOps® and the operational positioning.
Sections use semantic headings (H1 for hero, H2 for major sections).
Copy naturally incorporates the provided SEO keyword phrases (or close grammatical variants) without keyword stuffing.
No copy introduces “AI hype” phrasing or flashy tech claims.

file_operations.description: Set an SEO-appropriate document title and add a meta description aligned with PropertyOps® positioning (property operations services, documented delivery, standardized workflows).

Ensure semantic heading structure (single H1 in hero; H2 for major sections) and incorporate the provided SEO keyword phrases naturally throughout the relevant sections while keeping the tone calm and operational.

requirements.summary: Add credibility-forward, compliance-friendly messaging emphasizing U.S.-based operations support, documented delivery, and standardized processes without legal guarantees.
acceptanceCriteria: Technology section explicitly states operations are supported by internal systems and managed by a U.S.-based operations team.
Website emphasizes standardized workflows, digital checklists, and photo documentation as part of documented delivery.
Copy avoids legal/immigration guarantees (e.g., does not claim approval outcomes) while remaining credibility-focused.

file_operations.description: Refine Technology & Systems, Quality Control, and Trust/Differentiators copy blocks to explicitly state U.S.-based operations team support, documented delivery (workflows, checklists, photo documentation), and avoid legal/immigration guarantees.
Add a brief, compliance-friendly credibility note reinforcing standardized processes and documented delivery, avoiding guarantees or legal claims.

requirements.summary: Add the generated brand visuals as static assets and use them in the hero, how-it-works, quality control, and trust sections (no backend image routing).
acceptanceCriteria: All generated images are placed under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced directly by the frontend.
Icons appear in at least: How It Works, Technology & Systems, Quality Control, and Trust/Differentiators sections.
At least one diagram/flow graphic is displayed in the How It Works section (or adjacent) to visualize the 3-step process.
